mechanism_narrative: A higher level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) directly increases consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as markets anticipate stronger economic activity.
evidence_refs: fact:PAYEMS growth precedes S&P 500 earnings acceleration by 5 days
failure_condition: PAYEMS level above 145,000 thousand fails to produce positive 5-day returns in 55%+ of instances (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes that depress equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
evidence_refs: doc:2015-2017 Fed rate hike response to inflation
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% correlates with positive 20-day returns in 45%+ of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS rate hikes and UNRATE declines indicate a tightening cycle without labor market deterioration, boosting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
evidence_refs: fact:2015-2017 co-movement of policy tightening and labor strength
failure_condition: Joint FEDFUNDS rise + UNRATE fall fails to yield positive returns in 55%+ of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%), the Fed's aggressive rate hikes suppress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns despite strong growth.
evidence_refs: doc:1970s Fed policy response to inflation
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% correlates with positive returns in 45%+ of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing output, increasing corporate margins and driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through stronger earnings visibility.
evidence_refs: fact:INDPRO growth leads S&P 500 earnings by 15 days
failure_condition: INDPRO above 100 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in 55%+ of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1100 thousand units signal weakening residential demand, reducing consumer confidence and triggering negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST decline precedes S&P 500 drawdowns by 20 days
failure_condition: HOUST < 1100 correlates with positive returns in 40%+ of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent INDPRO declines and HOUST drops indicate broad economic contraction, reducing corporate revenue visibility and causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
evidence_refs: fact:2008-2009 co-contraction of manufacturing and housing
failure_condition: Joint INDPRO decline + HOUST drop fails to yield negative returns in 55%+ of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer spending surges (RSAFS > $470 billion) boost retail sales and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns through sustained earnings momentum.
evidence_refs: fact:RSAFS growth leads S&P 500 earnings by 45 days
failure_condition: RSAFS > $470 billion correlates with negative returns in 40%+ of cases.
